content.thinking:
multiprocessing Pool fails due to /dev/shm restrictions (no POSIX semaphores available in this container). The task statement says "No sockets, System V IPC, namespaces or surviving background processes across tool calls."

So I can't use multiprocessing. Let me use threads instead — but the work is CPU-bound in numpy/scipy which releases the GIL sometimes... Actually subprocess.run releases the GIL while waiting, so threads would work: each thread spawns a planner subprocess and waits. With 4 threads, I get 4 concurrent planner processes.

Let me rewrite the campaign with ThreadPoolExecutor.

arguments.command:
cd /app/work && python3 - <<'PYEOF'
s=open('campaign.py').read()
s=s.replace("from multiprocessing import Pool", "from concurrent.futures import ThreadPoolExecutor")
s=s.replace("""    with Pool(4) as pool:
        for seed, kind, err, info in pool.imap_unordered(worker, tasks, chunksize=2):""",
"""    with ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=4) as pool:
        for seed, kind, err, info in pool.map(worker, tasks):""")
open('campaign.py','w').write(s)
PYEOF
cd /app/work && timeout 1200 python3 campaign.py 240 500000 2>&1 | tail -22
